name: Jcode
subtitle: AI coding agent in your pocket
promotionalText: Chat with your Jcode coding agent running on your own cloud machine. Start tasks, follow tool calls live and review answers from anywhere.
description:
Jcode is an open-source AI coding agent. Jcode for iPhone connects to your Jcode Cloud machine so you can keep working with your agent away from your desk.

- Sign in with Google or a one-time email code.
- Chat with the agent in multiple session tabs.
- Watch tool calls, file edits and command output stream in as the agent works.
- Read rich Markdown answers with code blocks.
- Your cloud machine wakes on demand and sleeps when idle.

A Jcode Cloud subscription is managed on jcode.sh. You can permanently delete your account from Settings inside the app.

review.notes: Sign in: type appreview@jcode.sh in the email field, tap 'Email me a code', then enter the six-digit code given in the password field. No email is needed for this account. After sign-in the app wakes the account's cloud machine (about 30 seconds) and opens a chat. Send any message, for example 'Write a hello world in Rust', to see the agent respond. Account deletion: Settings (gear icon) > Delete account. The app does not offer in-app purchases. Subscriptions are sold only on jcode.sh and the app contains no purchase links.
